column1: # Vocabulary introduced by the Polski krok po kroku lessons and not already in the corpus.
# The file name keeps this list last in the topic glob. Ids are handed out in load
# order, so a file sorting earlier would renumber every word after it and scramble
# which word a stored favourite points at.
# Krok po kroku is monolingual: the books print these words with no translation, so
# every English gloss here is authored. Headwords are normalised — the books print
# "spać (śpię, śpisz)" and "zamawiać/zamówić", which map back to their entries here
